cause_quote: The original mac node runtime decoded camera params as `let params = (try? Self.decodeParams(ClawdisCameraClipParams.self, from: req.paramsJSON)) ??` with a default-params fallback, so a malformed payload silently became an all-defaults request.
user_saw: A raw node.invoke caller sending a mistyped field (e.g. includeAudio:"no") got a default capture reported as ok, including microphone recording it tried to opt out of, instead of an INVALID_REQUEST error.
summary: MacNodeRuntime now decodes camera.snap/clip, screen.record, location.get and canvas.present params once before permission checks and returns INVALID_REQUEST when supplied params do not decode, instead of falling back to defaults.
reasoning: The `(try? decodeParams(...)) ?? Params()` fallback was present in the first version of the mac node runtime (1fbd84da, Clawdis path, camera snap/clip) and carried through the clawdbot/openclaw renames and fd95ededaab refactor unchanged; location/screen.record handlers copied the same pattern later. No commit broke a working strict decode, so it is never-worked; confidence medium because the cause commit predates the graft and was checked only via the GitHub commit patch, and several handlers were added in sibling commits with the same pattern.
